notes.title: World Zero: The Red Update
notes.content:
A mini update dedicated solely to Red! Red has been the least amount equippable items since the first build of the game and her only armour was accidentally given to Shouta instead. Not only that but her high guaranteed damage essentially trivializes the game.
So this mini update aims to fix all that with all new updates and balance changes!

[h1]Character Balancing[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/32053f0ee48d9a0b82b551acac7a080747ba4bea.png[/img]
[h1]What's New?[/h1]
[h2]New armours have been added for Red[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/81cccdd3864250833f3159b3a355f7fe091030ff.png[/img]

[h1]But that's not all![/h1]
[h2]The open Beta has also received an update! Fast travel will now be available in beta!(Technically it's in both builds just inaccessible to the main game)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/5d219459c671daf25181ab0ae6f4c923aade8e1d.png[/img]


[h2][b]How to opt into beta:[/b][/h2]
1. Right click on the application itself on the steam library and go to "Properties".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/a69f801c186118d0dee1f2fff880c414185f88c5.png[/img]

2. Next, go to the "Betas" tab
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/32ec58ba276bf0a549b7b3adcee24ea4a63befdf.png[/img]

3. Now pick the option "openbeta"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/5c8a4091f97cdb1b905dd61a778739aab5d9cc23.png[/img]

4. The game should now update to allow access to the World Zero: Blood and Steel beta!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/9103914997a4f6359b21bde69e725190efe9f82a.png[/img]

notes.title: World Zero: Blood and Steel (Beta)
notes.content:
So after a long 2 years of development, The Blood and Steel update is... halfway done!

So why am I releasing this? Normally I would prefer to release a finish product as first impressions matter a lot but as it's stated it's been way too long and it might stay that way for a while before anything releases  as how my real life has been going is that it's been very busy.  However, this will not be in the main build of the game but instead a separate build that you need to access through steam itself

Before playing the early builds I'd like to mention few things:
1. THERE WILL BE BUGS(or might I don't know if there's enough content to warrant bugs)
2. A lot of elements of new content are either unfinished or left out entirely
3. The only thing that is done so far are the main quests

[b][u]New content:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] WASD Movement
[*] Reworked Ferris, Kuromi and Shinji's fights
[*] Gave Shouta the move "Paper Ball"
[*] Added Stray Dogs as a random encounter to Klison City so there's a reliable way to get money
[*] Added a character theme for Abigail
[*] Item rebalance
[*] Added more unique voices
[/list]

[b][u]Beta content:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Added a whole new side plot
[*] Added a new area to explore
[*] One new boss fight
[/list]


[b][u]Known issues:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The new party member has been left out as his quest line does not have any progress yet
[*] The quest "Rat Race" cannot be progressed
[*] There is a fast travel station which "works" but it doesn't go anywhere
[*] Some parts of the game has no dialogue voice
[*] and many minor issues that I can't think off at the top of my head
[*] Bellamy's whole segment doesn't have custom audio
[/list]

Feedback on the current content would be greatly appreciated

[h2][b]How to opt into beta:[/b][/h2]
1. Right click on the application itself on the steam library and go to "Properties".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/a69f801c186118d0dee1f2fff880c414185f88c5.png[/img]

2. Next, go to the "Betas" tab
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/32ec58ba276bf0a549b7b3adcee24ea4a63befdf.png[/img]

3. Now pick the option "openbeta"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/5c8a4091f97cdb1b905dd61a778739aab5d9cc23.png[/img]

4. The game should now update to allow access to the World Zero: Blood and Steel beta!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/9103914997a4f6359b21bde69e725190efe9f82a.png[/img]

notes.title: World Zero: Blood and Steel Announcement
notes.content:
Now that the Overhaul update is up and ready, it's time for those promised "future updates"(or at least one of them). This update would include new features like a new party member, a new side plot, many new side quests, etc. and new quality of life changes like fast travel so the game no longer feel linear as you're able to revisit past areas, unique message sounds for each character and battle backs!

Not really much else to say other than the progress on all the current content being worked on so you guys would know how much needs to be done.
- New party member: his design is done and his playstyle concept is don but he still needs to be implemented into the game
- New side plot: basically done story wise but the events still need to be made
- Side quests: Tested and the quest log works. Still need to code them into the game
- Fast Travel: Works but still need to make the fast travel stations for each area
- Unique message sounds: Most of the update characters already have voices and a few of the main cast has them too(The message sounds might only be for the new area when the update releases and the rest of the areas would be through future patches)
- Battle backs: This is basically backgrounds for the fights in game. No progress on this though as it's on the lowest in the priority list right now.

Release date: The Update will come out when it's ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43012190/67b36ba3e7d2c9163d2091b45ebbe3bfe21c95cd.png[/img]
